1"""Heading candidacy, font-size leveling, and numbering alignment. 

2 

3This module hosts the per-sub-document pipeline steps: 

4 

5 step 1 candidate gate — outline / font-size tiers / numbering / bold / 

6 centered-companion channels, strong-body demotion, homophone and 

7 caption vetoes, CB5 low-confidence tier gating, CB1 density 

8 re-estimation; 

9 step 2 pure font-size leveling (size bands → consecutive levels; intra- 

10 band order: centered-unnumbered < numbered (priority / unit 

11 sub-order / MultiLevelNum raw level on an independent track) < 

12 uncentered-unnumbered); 

13 step 3 top-level backfill (CnChapter/EnChapter/EnNum absorbed as 

14 MultiLevelNum raw level 1 on ordinal-linkage evidence); 

15 step 4 same-series numbering level alignment (open-interval series, 

16 level mode with shallow tie-break, subtree shift). 

17 

18Anchoring (two-round outline locking), merge/demote and skeleton 

19correction build on these decisions in later steps. 

20""" 

21

89def _strong_body_with_outline_context( 

90 text: str, 

91 outline_level: int | None, 

92 strong_body: Callable[[str], str | None], 

93) -> tuple[str | None, bool]: 

94 """Apply the narrow physical-outline guard to a strong-body verdict. 

95 

96 Pinned spaCy models sometimes create sentence boundaries from dependency 

97 ROOTs alone (``承诺`` | ``书``, ``总`` | ``则``, ``AD_`` fragments). A 

98 physical outline outweighs that NLP-only signal unless the title prose 

99 also contains a visible internal sentence terminator. All other 

100 strong-body reasons retain their original force. 

101 

102 NOTE: as of the same-terminator gate added to 

103 :func:`guardrails.strong_body_reason`, the DEFAULT ``strong_body`` never 

104 returns ``strong_body_multi_sentence`` without a visible internal 

105 terminator, so this guard's sparing branch is unreachable on the default 

106 path (the same corroboration now runs at the source, and covers non-outline 

107 lines too). It is retained as defense-in-depth for INJECTED ``strong_body`` 

108 callbacks (e.g. test stubs) that bypass the source gate. 

109 """ 

110 reason = strong_body(text) 

111 spared = ( 

112 outline_level is not None 

113 and reason == "strong_body_multi_sentence" 

114 and not guardrails.has_explicit_internal_sentence_boundary(text) 

115 ) 

116 return (None, True) if spared else (reason, False)

136@dataclass 

137class HeadingDecision: 

138 """Mutable per-record heading verdict threaded through the pipeline.""" 

139 

140 record_index: int 

141 text: str 

142 is_heading: bool = False 

143 level: int | None = None 

144 font_size_pt: float | None = None 

145 outline_level: int | None = None # 0-based physical outline 

146 numbering: NumberingClassification | None = None 

147 centered: bool = False 

148 all_bold: bool = False 

149 anchored: bool = False # outline-locked bookkeeping (both anchoring rounds) 

150 #: level derives from PHYSICAL OUTLINE evidence — set only by 

151 #: anchor_outline_levels round 1 

152 #: (a member of a numbered series that has ≥1 outlined member, so the whole 

153 #: series is anchored to the outline mode). Distinct from ``anchored``, 

154 #: which also covers round-2 size-only propagation. Used as a hard boundary 

155 #: by the subtree demotion (demote_strong_body_headings) so an 

156 #: outline-anchored series is not split 

157 #: (a no-outline member 1) is not demoted while its outlined 2)/3) survive). 

158 outline_anchored: bool = False 

159 pre_anchor_level: int | None = None # level before round-1 anchoring 

160 is_title_block: bool = False 

161 composed_heading: str | None = None # title block: the compound heading 

162 #: title block: main + sub, double-space joined and length-bounded — the 

163 #: value that lands as the H1 and the doc_title (see compose_doc_title). 

164 doc_title_heading: str | None = None 

165 title_parts: tuple[str, ...] = () 

166 member_indices: tuple[int, ...] = () 

167 use_raw_text: bool = False 

168 absorbed: bool = False # merged into a preceding heading (merge_split_headings) 

169 rule_trail: list[str] = field(default_factory=list) 

170 

171 def note(self, rule: str) -> None: 

172 self.rule_trail.append(rule) 

173 

174 @property 

175 def anchor_delta(self) -> int: 

176 """Round-1 level shift (post - pre); 0 when not anchored.""" 

177 if not self.anchored or self.pre_anchor_level is None or self.level is None: 177 ↛ 178line 177 didn't jump to line 178 because the condition on line 177 was never true

178 return 0 

179 return self.level - self.pre_anchor_level

187def _record_weight(rec: Any) -> int: 

188 """Char weight for FS_base statistics. 

189 

190 Prefers the visible source-text count (w:t only) so auto-numbering labels 

191 and ``<sup>``/``<equation>``/``<drawing>``/``<table>`` placeholder markup 

192 never skew the body-size mode. Falls back to the stripped assembly text 

193 when the count was not computed (manually built records / smart-off).""" 

194 vc = getattr(rec, "visible_char_count", None) 

195 if vc is not None: 

196 return vc 

197 return len((rec.text or "").strip()) 

198 

199 

200def _stat_paragraphs(records: Sequence[Any], indices: Sequence[int]) -> list[int]: 

201 """Record indices that participate in FS_base statistics: 

202 paragraphs only — tables/cells, empty paragraphs and TOC lines are out.""" 

203 out = [] 

204 for i in indices: 

205 rec = records[i] 

206 if rec.kind != "para" or rec.is_toc_field or rec.is_toc_link: 

207 continue 

208 if _record_weight(rec) <= 0: 

209 continue 

210 out.append(i) 

211 return out

214def document_fs_base( 

215 records: Sequence[Any], 

216 indices: Sequence[int], 

217 *, 

218 confidence_ratio: float | None = None, 

219) -> FsBase: 

220 ratio = ( 

221 confidence_ratio 

222 if confidence_ratio is not None 

223 else _env_float( 

224 "DOCX_SMART_CONFIDENCE_RATIO", DEFAULT_DOCX_SMART_CONFIDENCE_RATIO 

225 ) 

226 ) 

227 pairs = [ 

228 (records[i].font_size_pt, _record_weight(records[i])) 

229 for i in _stat_paragraphs(records, indices) 

230 if records[i].font_size_pt is not None 

231 ] 

232 return compute_fs_base(pairs, confidence_ratio=ratio)

235def _log_physical_feature_summary( 

236 records: Sequence[Any], body_indices: Sequence[int], doc_fs: FsBase 

237) -> None: 

238 """Emit a one-line document-level summary once physical features are 

239 extracted: the body FS_base (over body paragraphs, its natural scope), 

240 the total paragraph count and the per-outline-level histogram (over all 

241 ``para`` records, the physical view). Outline levels are shown 1-based 

242 (``L1`` == outline_level 0, i.e. Word "Level 1"); paragraphs without an 

243 outline fall in the ``none`` bucket.""" 

244 total_paras = 0 

245 outline_hist: dict[int | None, int] = {} 

246 for rec in records: 

247 if rec.kind != "para": 

248 continue 

249 total_paras += 1 

250 lv = rec.outline_level 

251 outline_hist[lv] = outline_hist.get(lv, 0) + 1 

252 

253 parts = [ 

254 f"L{lv + 1}: {outline_hist[lv]}" 

255 for lv in sorted(k for k in outline_hist if k is not None) 

256 ] 

257 if None in outline_hist: 257 ↛ 259line 257 didn't jump to line 259 because the condition on line 257 was always true

258 parts.append(f"none: {outline_hist[None]}") 

259 levels_str = ", ".join(parts) if parts else "(none)" 

260 

261 fs_str = f"{doc_fs.size_pt}pt" if doc_fs.size_pt is not None else "unknown" 

262 confidence = "high" if doc_fs.confidence_high else "low" 

263 logger.info( 

264 "[smart_heading] physical features: FS_base=%s (confidence=%s), " 

265 "%d paragraphs {%s}", 

266 fs_str, 

267 confidence, 

268 total_paras, 

269 levels_str, 

270 )

273def _center_pad_events( 

274 records: Sequence[Any], body_indices: Sequence[int] 

275) -> list[dict]: 

276 """Audit rows for paragraphs whose ``w:jc=center`` a leading space pad 

277 defeated (``guardrails.is_visually_centered``). 

278 

279 Emitted from ``run_smart_heading`` — a per-document terminal point — and 

280 NOT from ``gate_candidates``, whose first pass may be discarded by a CB1 

281 re-estimation (a counter incremented there would drift or double). The 

282 property is purely physical, so one scan of the records is equivalent to 

283 what every gate pass sees. 

284 

285 This is the only trace such a paragraph leaves: it matches no rule 

286 afterwards and so takes ``gate_candidates``' silent ``continue`` without 

287 producing a decision, leaving a later "why did my centered heading vanish" 

288 with nothing to read. Values are ints/floats/strs in scan order — 

289 deterministic and replayable. 

290 """ 

291 return [ 

292 { 

293 "rule": "center_pad_offset", 

294 "index": i, 

295 "pad_em": round(records[i].leading_pad_em, 2), 

296 } 

297 for i in body_indices 

298 if records[i].alignment == "center" 

299 and not guardrails.is_visually_centered(records[i]) 

300 ] 

301

303# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

304# step 1 — candidate gate 

305# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

306 

307#: styleKeys whose strong-body check runs at recognition time — per-paragraph, 

308#: with NO series propagation. Reserved for the CHAPTER classes: a chapter is 

309#: almost always a real heading, so a single long chapter title must not drag 

310#: its whole series to body via the post-merge CB2 majority rule; demoting only 

311#: itself is safer. CLAUSE classes (条/款/项, Article/§) are NOT here — they 

312#: defer to the post-merge sweep like CnParentNum / MultiLevelNum / EnNum, so a 

313#: run of body-in-disguise clauses is demoted as a whole series and short 

314#: colon-lead survivors don't leak through as headings. 

315EARLY_STRONG_BODY_KEYS = frozenset({CN_CHAPTER, EN_CHAPTER})

318@dataclass 

319class GateResult: 

320 decisions: list[HeadingDecision] # admitted candidates, document order 

321 fs_base: FsBase 

322 density: float # candidates / non-empty paragraphs 

323 non_empty: int = 0 # denominator behind ``density`` (non-empty, non-TOC paras) 

324 cb1_reestimated: bool = False 

325 cb1_tripped: bool = False # still too dense after one re-estimation 

326 #: CB1 spared the sub-document without re-estimation: the raw first-pass 

327 #: density was over threshold, but a look-ahead of the downstream 

328 #: strong-body + CB2 series-propagation sweep projected it back under the 

329 #: bar, so the trip was withheld. Real demotion is left to the 

330 #: normal post-merge sweep. 

331 cb1_strong_body_recovered: bool = False 

332 cb1_new_fs: float | None = None # re-estimated FS_base (audit) 

333 #: Second-pass mean body chars between adjacent candidates (observational 

334 #: only — the CB1 recheck is density-only; None when < 2 candidates). 

335 cb1_new_inter_chars: float | None = None 

336 #: Recognition-time strong-body demotions. Kept apart from ``decisions`` 

337 #: (they must not be leveled/anchored) but carry a rule-tagged 

338 #: ``HeadingDecision`` so every demotion is explicit and audited, never a 

339 #: silent drop. OUTLINE members bear the I2 weight — they were 

340 #: baseline headings, so they re-render from ``full_text_raw`` 

341 #: (``use_raw_text``) and the retention check sees the rule trail. 

342 #: NON-outline members were never baseline headings: they exist purely 

343 #: so the per-paragraph audit ledger matches the demotion counter, and stay 

344 #: output-neutral (``use_raw_text`` off → same body rendering as no 

345 #: decision). 

346 demoted: list[HeadingDecision] = field(default_factory=list) 

347 #: Paragraphs whose numbering identity was revoked by ``numbering_veto`` and 

348 #: which then matched no promotion rule (silently dropped at recognition). 

349 #: Rule-tagged output-neutral (``is_heading=False``) decisions carrying the 

350 #: veto reason, kept purely so the audit ledger records WHY a would-be 

351 #: numbered candidate became body — otherwise the veto leaves no trace. 

352 #: Always non-outline (outline paragraphs are never numbering-vetoed, P3). 

353 veto_suppressed: list[HeadingDecision] = field(default_factory=list) 

354 #: Paragraphs the title-block LLM named a heading (``llm_heading_grants``) 

355 #: that then matched no promotion rule. The LLM vote is NOT an admission 

356 #: rule (only its body veto has force), so these are ledger-only, 

357 #: output-neutral decisions tagged ``llm_grant_rejected`` — the audit 

358 #: records that an LLM heading vote was overruled by the normal gate. 

359 #: A paragraph whose numbering was ALSO homophone-vetoed lands here (one 

360 #: decision carrying both marks), not in ``veto_suppressed``. Grants 

361 #: stopped earlier by the caption / LLM-body vetoes are deliberately NOT 

362 #: recorded: those vetoes carry their own semantics. 

363 grant_rejected: list[HeadingDecision] = field(default_factory=list) 

364 #: CB1 graduated demotion: the ladder stages actually applied, in 

365 #: demotion order. Empty unless the ladder ran AND found a converging prefix 

366 #: (see ``_try_cb1_graduated_demotion``). When non-empty the three 

367 #: breaker/recovery flags above (``cb1_reestimated`` / ``cb1_tripped`` / 

368 #: ``cb1_strong_body_recovered``) stay False — the first-pass result is kept 

369 #: and the normal downstream sweep runs; the ladder's members move into 

370 #: ``demoted``. 

371 cb1_graduated_stages: list[str] = field(default_factory=list) 

372 cb1_graduated_demoted: int = 0 # count of candidates the ladder demoted 

373 #: Projected density / mean inter-heading body chars at the ladder's 

374 #: stopping point (measured on the strong-body+CB2 projection — the DECISION 

375 #: basis). Deliberately NOT written back to ``density``, which keeps its 

376 #: real-decisions definition (the projection can drop more than the real 

377 #: result, whose remaining strong-body candidates the downstream sweep 

378 #: handles). 

379 cb1_graduated_density: float | None = None 

380 cb1_graduated_inter_chars: float | None = None 

381 #: The same-size EnNum series was folded into the MLN family as its implicit 

382 #: level-1 root and demoted last (see ``_cb1_ennum_is_mln_root``). 

383 cb1_graduated_ennum_root: bool = False

391def gate_candidates( 

392 records: Sequence[Any], 

393 indices: Sequence[int], 

394 *, 

395 fs_base: FsBase, 

396 strong_body: Callable[[str], str | None] | None = None, 

397 numbering_veto: Callable[[Any, str], str | None] | None = None, 

398 caption_veto: Callable[[str], str | None] | None = None, 

399 warnings: dict | None = None, 

400 force_low_confidence: bool = False, 

401 cb1_reestimate: bool = False, 

402 llm_heading_grants: set[int] = frozenset(), 

403 llm_body_vetoes: set[int] = frozenset(), 

404) -> GateResult: 

405 """Candidate gate (step 1) over one sub-document (``indices`` into ``records``). 

406 

407 ``llm_heading_grants`` are record indices the title-block LLM classified 

408 as plain headings. The vote carries NO admission force — a granted 

409 paragraph must still pass the normal promotion rules below (an LLM 

410 heading vote proved unreliable: running headers / TOC lines got granted). 

411 The set is kept for auditing only: a grant that then matches no rule is 

412 recorded in ``GateResult.grant_rejected``. 

413 ``llm_body_vetoes`` are indices the LLM classified as body — candidate 

414 identity revoked (only the veto side of the partition has force); 

415 outline paragraphs never appear here (title_block already reroutes them 

416 per I2). 

417 

418 ``cb1_reestimate`` switches to the CB1 second-pass semantics: 

419 same-size composite paths (series / bold / centered) are all disabled, 

420 while sizes strictly above the re-estimated FS_base remain auto-admitted; 

421 outline pass-through is unaffected. 

422 

423 Zero-visible-char paragraphs (pure ``<drawing>``/``<object>``/ 

424 ``<equation>`` placeholder lines) are never candidates and never lend 

425 companion evidence (numbering series / weak pair / centered runs). 

426 Non-outline ones are skipped silently (output-neutral) — EXCEPT a 

427 granted one, which still lands in ``grant_rejected`` with a 

428 ``zero_visible_chars`` mark. Outline ones take an explicit rule-tagged 

429 ``placeholder_demoted`` decision in ``demoted`` (I2); the caller counts 

430 and logs those at final adoption, since this gate may run twice per 

431 sub-document under CB1. 

432 """ 

433 strong_body = strong_body or guardrails.strong_body_reason 

434 numbering_veto = numbering_veto or guardrails.numbering_homophone_reason 

435 caption_veto = caption_veto or guardrails.caption_prefix_reason 

436 

437 high_conf = fs_base.confidence_high and not force_low_confidence 

438 fs = fs_base.size_pt 

439 

440 para_indices = [ 

441 i 

442 for i in indices 

443 if records[i].kind == "para" 

444 and not records[i].is_toc_field 

445 and not records[i].is_toc_link 

446 ] 

447 

448 # Pre-classify numbering (with homophone veto) for every paragraph. 

449 # Zero-visible-char paragraphs (pure <drawing>/<object>/<equation> 

450 # placeholders) classify as None: an auto-numbered image line must not 

451 # lend a second series vote to an otherwise-singleton numbered paragraph 

452 # (base_series / weak_plus_series / lowconf_series). 

453 numbering: dict[int, NumberingClassification | None] = {} 

454 veto_notes: dict[int, str] = {} 

455 for i in para_indices: 

456 if _record_weight(records[i]) <= 0: 

457 numbering[i] = None 

458 continue 

459 cls = classify_numbering( 

460 records[i].text, numbering_format=records[i].numbering_format 

461 ) 

462 if cls is not None: 

463 veto = numbering_veto(cls, records[i].text) 

464 if veto is not None: 

465 veto_notes[i] = veto 

466 cls = None 

467 numbering[i] = cls 

468 # Deferred single-char roman reclassification (needs the whole list). 

469 reclassified = reclassify_single_char_romans([numbering[i] for i in para_indices]) 

470 for i, cls in zip(para_indices, reclassified): 

471 numbering[i] = cls 

472 

473 # Series population per key (含自身): the "成套编号" gate. 

474 series_count: dict[tuple, int] = {} 

475 for i in para_indices: 

476 cls = numbering[i] 

477 if cls is not None: 

478 series_count[cls.series_key()] = series_count.get(cls.series_key(), 0) + 1 

479 

480 def _in_series(i: int) -> bool: 

481 cls = numbering[i] 

482 return cls is not None and series_count.get(cls.series_key(), 0) >= 2 

483 

484 # The EFFECTIVE verdict is cached deliberately: an outline paragraph 

485 # spared from an NLP-only pseudo split also participates as valid evidence 

486 # in centered/weak-size companion checks below. That is a narrow behavioral 

487 # spillover, but it is consistent with treating the physical-outline line 

488 # as a genuine heading rather than strong-body evidence. 

489 strong_cache: dict[int, tuple[str | None, bool]] = {} 

490 

491 def _strong(i: int) -> str | None: 

492 if i not in strong_cache: 

493 rec = records[i] 

494 strong_cache[i] = _strong_body_with_outline_context( 

495 rec.text, rec.outline_level, strong_body 

496 ) 

497 return strong_cache[i][0] 

498 

499 def _outline_multisentence_spared(i: int) -> bool: 

500 cached = strong_cache.get(i) 

501 return cached is not None and cached[1] 

502 

503 def _short(i: int) -> bool: 

504 # Candidate shortness reuses the strong-body length cap. 

505 return ( 

506 guardrails.weighted_char_length(records[i].text.strip()) 

507 <= guardrails.heading_max_chars() 

508 ) 

509 

510 def _title_short(i: int) -> bool: 

511 from .title_block import TITLE_LINE_MAX_WEIGHTED_CHARS 

512 

513 return ( 

514 guardrails.weighted_char_length(records[i].text.strip()) 

515 <= TITLE_LINE_MAX_WEIGHTED_CHARS 

516 ) 

517 

518 # Solo centered channel: under a HIGH-confidence FS_base, a 

519 # centered short line free of every body signal is heading-shaped on its 

520 # own — no companion needed (a two-line centered title has none). The 

521 # shape gate carries the exclusions that make solo admission safe: strong 

522 # body, genuine numbering, captions (图*/表*), a bare 成文日期 (a centered 

523 # 落款 date), letter-free decoration lines (page numbers ``- 1 -``, 

524 # separators ``***``), and — via is_visually_centered — a line whose 

525 # w:jc=center is defeated by a wide leading space pad (the 落款/署名 an 

526 # author positions bottom-right by padding a centered paragraph). 

527 # Known residue (documented, not coded around): a centered issuer/signature 

528 # line or slogan that is NOT space-padded is shape-identical to a real 

529 # title — strong-body / LLM-veto / imprint-preceding cover most, and the 

530 # CB1 density breaker backstops centered-heavy documents. 

531 # Lines still group into runs (consecutive without an intervening body 

532 # paragraph): a run of >= _CENTER_RUN_MAX centered lines is a poem / 

533 # poster cluster and the whole run loses THIS channel — losing the 

534 # channel is not a veto; outline / numbering / size / bold paths stay 

535 # open. Under a LOW-confidence FS_base the companion requirement stands 

536 # (require_companion=True): a same-size centered line from a DIFFERENT 

537 # run (adjacent centered lines are never companions). 

538 centered_shape: dict[int, bool] = {} 

539 for i in para_indices: 

540 rec = records[i] 

541 centered_shape[i] = ( 

542 guardrails.is_visually_centered(rec) 

543 # A zero-visible-char placeholder is not a centered "line": it 

544 # neither takes the channel nor joins a centered run (a decorative 

545 # image between title lines must not push the run over the 

546 # anti-poetry cap). It does not BREAK runs either — the run-build 

547 # loop below only breaks on weighted paragraphs. 

548 and _record_weight(rec) > 0 

549 and i not in llm_body_vetoes # confirmed body is no companion 

550 and _title_short(i) 

551 and _strong(i) is None 

552 and numbering[i] is None 

553 and caption_veto(records[i].text) is None 

554 and not guardrails.is_document_date(records[i].text) 

555 and not guardrails.is_symbolic_line(records[i].text) 

556 ) 

557 runs: list[list[int]] = [] 

558 current_run: list[int] = [] 

559 for i in para_indices: 

560 if centered_shape[i]: 

561 current_run.append(i) 

562 elif records[i].kind == "para" and _record_weight(records[i]) > 0: 

563 if current_run: 

564 runs.append(current_run) 

565 current_run = [] 

566 if current_run: 

567 runs.append(current_run) 

568 run_of: dict[int, int] = {} 

569 for ridx, run in enumerate(runs): 

570 for i in run: 

571 run_of[i] = ridx 

572 

573 def _centered_channel(i: int, *, require_companion: bool = False) -> bool: 

574 if not centered_shape.get(i): 

575 return False 

576 my_run = run_of.get(i) 

577 if my_run is None or len(runs[my_run]) >= _CENTER_RUN_MAX: 

578 return False # anti-poetry: a long centered cluster, whole run out 

579 if not require_companion: 

580 return True 

581 my_size = _effective_size(records[i]) 

582 for ridx, run in enumerate(runs): 

583 if ridx == my_run or len(run) >= _CENTER_RUN_MAX: 

584 continue 

585 for j in run: 

586 if _effective_size(records[j]) == my_size: 

587 return True 

588 return False 

589 

590 # Weak-signal companions (P2): count of same-size weak-tier paragraphs. 

591 # A strong-body paragraph will be demoted and so is NOT a companion — 

592 # only weak-signal paragraphs free of strong-body features count. Excluding it 

593 # here prevents a lone +0.5 paragraph from falsely pairing with a same-size 

594 # sentence/long paragraph that is about to be dropped. 

595 weak_size_count: dict[float, int] = {} 

596 if fs is not None: 596 ↛ 609line 596 didn't jump to line 609 because the condition on line 596 was always true

597 for i in para_indices: 

598 size = _effective_size(records[i]) 

599 if ( 

600 size is not None 

601 and size == fs + 0.5 

602 and _strong(i) is None 

603 # A placeholder's synthesized style size is no weak-signal 

604 # evidence — it cannot be the companion vote. 

605 and _record_weight(records[i]) > 0 

606 ): 

607 weak_size_count[size] = weak_size_count.get(size, 0) + 1 

608 

609 decisions: list[HeadingDecision] = [] 

610 demoted: list[HeadingDecision] = [] 

611 veto_suppressed: list[HeadingDecision] = [] 

612 grant_rejected: list[HeadingDecision] = [] 

613 admitted: set[int] = set() 

614 

615 for i in para_indices: 

616 rec = records[i] 

617 text = rec.text 

618 size = _effective_size(rec) 

619 cls = numbering[i] 

620 rule: str | None = None 

621 

622 if _record_weight(rec) <= 0: 

623 # Zero visible source characters — a pure <drawing>/<object>/ 

624 # <equation> placeholder paragraph. It carries no textual heading 

625 # evidence: its "font size" is style metadata synthesized by the 

626 # fallback cascade, not measured off text. Never a 

627 # heading, including outline members (user ruling) — but an 

628 # outline member was a baseline heading, so it takes an EXPLICIT 

629 # I2 demotion (use_raw_text re-renders the tag as body), never a 

630 # silent skip. Counting/logging happens at the FINAL adoption 

631 # merge, not here: gate_with_cb1 may run this gate twice. 

632 if rec.outline_level is not None: 

633 dem = HeadingDecision( 

634 record_index=i, 

635 text=text, 

636 is_heading=False, 

637 outline_level=rec.outline_level, 

638 use_raw_text=True, 

639 ) 

640 dem.note("zero_visible_chars") 

641 dem.note("placeholder_demoted") 

642 demoted.append(dem) 

643 elif i in llm_heading_grants: 

644 # LLM audit contract: a granted line that gets no rule must 

645 # land in grant_rejected, not vanish silently. 

646 supp = HeadingDecision( 

647 record_index=i, 

648 text=text, 

649 is_heading=False, 

650 outline_level=None, 

651 ) 

652 supp.note("zero_visible_chars") 

653 supp.note("llm_grant_rejected") 

654 grant_rejected.append(supp) 

655 # Other non-outline placeholders: silent continue, output-neutral 

656 # (the caption_veto P3 precedent — body rendering is unchanged). 

657 continue 

658 

659 if rec.outline_level is not None: 

660 # P3 never vetoes an outline paragraph — the one exception is the 

661 # zero-visible-char demotion above, which is rule-tagged and I2- 

662 # explicit, not a silent skip. Silently skipping here would strip 

663 # a baseline heading without a decision/warning and trip the I2 

664 # machine check. Wrong captions with an outline fall to the 

665 # strong-body / guardrail path like any outline para. 

666 rule = "outline" 

667 elif i in llm_body_vetoes: 

668 continue # LLM body vote revokes candidate identity 

669 elif caption_veto(text) is not None: 

670 continue # P3: never a heading 

671 elif fs is None or size is None: 671 ↛ 672line 671 didn't jump to line 672 because the condition on line 671 was never true

672 rule = None 

673 elif cb1_reestimate: 

674 # CB1 second pass: only a size strictly above the re-estimated 

675 # body size auto-admits; all same-size composite paths are off. 

676 if size > fs: 

677 rule = "cb1_size" 

678 elif high_conf: 

679 if size >= fs + 1.0: 

680 rule = "size_strong" 

681 elif size == fs + 0.5: 

682 if _in_series(i): 682 ↛ 683line 682 didn't jump to line 683 because the condition on line 682 was never true

683 rule = "weak_plus_series" 

684 elif rec.all_bold and _short(i): 684 ↛ 685line 684 didn't jump to line 685 because the condition on line 684 was never true

685 rule = "weak_plus_bold" 

686 elif _centered_channel(i): 686 ↛ 687line 686 didn't jump to line 687 because the condition on line 686 was never true

687 rule = "weak_plus_center" 

688 elif weak_size_count.get(size, 0) >= 2: 

689 rule = "weak_pair" # P2 companions 

690 elif size == fs: 

691 if _in_series(i): 

692 rule = "base_series" 

693 elif rec.all_bold and _short(i): 

694 rule = "base_bold" 

695 elif _centered_channel(i): 

696 rule = "base_center" 

697 # size < fs without outline: never a heading (necessary 

698 # condition under high confidence) 

699 else: 

700 # Low confidence (CB5 / CB1): no size tier stands alone; require 

701 # size >= fs AND a composite signal. 

702 if size >= fs: 702 ↛ 710line 702 didn't jump to line 710 because the condition on line 702 was always true

703 if _in_series(i): 

704 rule = "lowconf_series" 

705 elif rec.all_bold and _short(i): 705 ↛ 706line 705 didn't jump to line 706 because the condition on line 705 was never true

706 rule = "lowconf_bold" 

707 elif _centered_channel(i, require_companion=True): 

708 rule = "lowconf_center" 

709 

710 if rule is None: 

711 # Two ledger-only cases, NEVER a silent drop (both output-neutral: 

712 # use_raw_text stays off → same body rendering as no decision, and 

713 # both are non-outline — outline paragraphs took rule="outline"): 

714 # - a numbering veto revoked this paragraph's numbering identity 

715 # and it then matched no promotion rule → record WHY; 

716 # - the title-block LLM named it a heading but the vote carries no 

717 # admission force and no normal rule matched → record that the 

718 # grant was overruled (``llm_grant_rejected``). A paragraph 

719 # hitting BOTH gets ONE decision carrying both marks (a second 

720 # decision would be dropped by the caller's setdefault merge) 

721 # and lands in ``grant_rejected``. 

722 if i in veto_notes or i in llm_heading_grants: 

723 supp = HeadingDecision( 

724 record_index=i, 

725 text=text, 

726 is_heading=False, 

727 outline_level=rec.outline_level, 

728 ) 

729 if i in veto_notes: 

730 supp.note(veto_notes[i]) 

731 supp.note("numbering_veto_suppressed") 

732 if i in llm_heading_grants: 

733 supp.note("llm_grant_rejected") 

734 grant_rejected.append(supp) 

735 else: 

736 veto_suppressed.append(supp) 

737 continue 

738 

739 # Strong-body demotion at recognition time: unnumbered candidates 

740 # and chapter-class numbered ones; clause-class and all other numbered 

741 # styleKeys defer to the post-merge sweep so CB2 series propagation can 

742 # demote a body-in-disguise run as a whole (see EARLY_STRONG_BODY_KEYS). 

743 check_now = cls is None or cls.style_key in EARLY_STRONG_BODY_KEYS 

744 if check_now: 

745 reason = _strong(i) 

746 if reason is not None: 

747 if warnings is not None: 

748 warnings["smart_strong_body_demotions"] = ( 

749 warnings.get("smart_strong_body_demotions", 0) + 1 

750 ) 

751 # Every recognition-time strong-body demotion leaves an 

752 # EXPLICIT, rule-tagged, per-paragraph decision — never a 

753 # silent drop — so the per-paragraph audit ledger matches the 

754 # demotion counter above. The demoted decision is kept out of 

755 # the leveled candidate list. Outline members bear the I2 

756 # weight: they were baseline headings, so they 

757 # re-render from full_text_raw (``use_raw_text``), the retention 

758 # check sees the rule trail, and the demotion is 

759 # warned. Non-outline candidates were never baseline headings — 

760 # they stay output-neutral (``use_raw_text`` off → same body 

761 # rendering as no decision) and emit no I2 warning. 

762 is_outline = rec.outline_level is not None 

763 dem = HeadingDecision( 

764 record_index=i, 

765 text=text, 

766 is_heading=False, 

767 outline_level=rec.outline_level, 

768 numbering=cls, 

769 use_raw_text=is_outline, 

770 ) 

771 dem.note(reason) 

772 dem.note("strong_body_demoted") 

773 if i in veto_notes: 773 ↛ 774line 773 didn't jump to line 774 because the condition on line 773 was never true

774 dem.note(veto_notes[i]) 

775 demoted.append(dem) 

776 if is_outline: 

777 logger.warning( 

778 "[smart_heading] I2: outline paragraph demoted to body " 

779 "by strong-body feature (%s)", 

780 reason, 

781 ) 

782 continue 

783 

784 decision = HeadingDecision( 

785 record_index=i, 

786 text=text, 

787 is_heading=True, 

788 font_size_pt=size, 

789 outline_level=rec.outline_level, 

790 numbering=cls, 

791 centered=guardrails.is_visually_centered(rec), 

792 all_bold=rec.all_bold, 

793 ) 

794 decision.note(rule) 

795 if i in veto_notes: 

796 decision.note(veto_notes[i]) 

797 if _outline_multisentence_spared(i): 

798 decision.note(_OUTLINE_MULTISENTENCE_SPARED) 

799 decisions.append(decision) 

800 admitted.add(i) 

801 

802 non_empty = len(para_indices) 

803 density = (len(decisions) / non_empty) if non_empty else 0.0 

804 return GateResult( 

805 decisions=decisions, 

806 fs_base=fs_base, 

807 density=density, 

808 non_empty=non_empty, 

809 demoted=demoted, 

810 veto_suppressed=veto_suppressed, 

811 grant_rejected=grant_rejected, 

812 )

815def _avg_inter_heading_body_chars( 

816 records: Sequence[Any], indices: Sequence[int], result: GateResult 

817) -> float | None: 

818 """Mean visible body chars between adjacent admitted candidates. 

819 

820 ``None`` when fewer than two candidates (no adjacent pair exists). 

821 """ 

822 cand = sorted(d.record_index for d in result.decisions) 

823 if len(cand) < 2: 

824 return None 

825 admitted = set(cand) 

826 body_chars = 0 

827 for i in indices: 

828 if cand[0] < i < cand[-1] and i not in admitted: 

829 rec = records[i] 

830 if rec.kind == "para": 830 ↛ 827line 830 didn't jump to line 827 because the condition on line 830 was always true

831 # CJK-weighted (1 Chinese = 3 English), same yardstick as 

832 # every other length threshold. 

833 body_chars += guardrails.weighted_char_length(rec.text) 

834 return body_chars / (len(cand) - 1) 

835 

836 

837# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

838# CB1 graduated demotion 

839# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

840# When CB1 would otherwise blanket-re-estimate FS_base and wipe EVERY same-size 

841# numbered heading (the "1 范围 / 5.2 版面 / 7.2.1 份号" GB/T shape), demote 

842# same-size candidates ONE evidence tier at a time in a fixed order (weakest 

843# body-prior first), re-checking density + inter-heading spacing after each 

844# tier, and STOP at the first prefix that brings both back within bounds. 

845# Deterministic: fixed ladder, no LLM. MultiLevelNum is demoted LAST and 

846# deepest-raw-level-first, so a numbered outline never loses a whole set at 

847# once (demoting "5" while keeping "5.2" would orphan the sub-levels). 

848 

849#: Non-MLN, non-chapter styleKey -> ladder stage tag. 

850_CB1_STAGE_BY_STYLE: dict[str, str] = { 

851 EN_SINGLE_PAREN: "en_single_paren", 

852 EN_DOUBLE_PAREN: "en_double_paren", 

853 EN_ALPHA: "en_alpha", 

854 ROMAN_NUM: "roman_num", 

855 EN_NUM: "en_num", 

856 CN_PARENT_NUM: "cn_parent_num", 

857 CN_NUM: "cn_num", 

858 CN_CLAUSE: "clause", 

859 EN_CLAUSE: "clause", 

860} 

861 

862#: Fixed non-MLN ladder order (weakest body-prior first). ``mln_raw{k}`` stages 

863#: are appended dynamically (deepest first) after this base; ``en_num`` moves to 

864#: the very end when it is the MLN family's implicit root (see below). 

865_CB1_BASE_LADDER: tuple[str, ...] = ( 

866 "en_single_paren", 

867 "en_double_paren", 

868 "en_alpha", 

869 "center", 

870 "bold", 

871 "roman_num", 

872 "en_num", 

873 "cn_parent_num", 

874 "cn_num", 

875 "clause", 

876) 

877 

878#: EnNum-as-MLN-root needs >= 2 distinct overlapping ordinals AND >= half the 

879#: MLN leading components covered. The >=2 floor mirrors ``backfill_top_level`` 

880#: ("exactly one linked pair never waives — too weak"); a lone {1} overlap is 

881#: near-zero evidence (every document starts at 1). 

882_CB1_ROOT_MIN_OVERLAP = 2 

883_CB1_ROOT_OVERLAP_RATIO = 0.5 

884 

885 

886def _cb1_stage_tag(d: HeadingDecision, fs: float | None) -> str | None: 

887 """The graduated-demotion ladder stage for a candidate, or ``None`` if it is 

888 EXEMPT (never demoted by the ladder): 

889 

890 - a physical-outline heading (I2 — outline is never CB1-demoted); 

891 - a candidate whose size is strictly above FS_base (real size evidence, and 

892 exactly what a blanket re-estimation would itself keep); 

893 - a chapter-class numbered heading (strongest numbering evidence, already 

894 guarded at recognition time by EARLY_STRONG_BODY_KEYS); 

895 - anything that maps to no stage (fail-safe: keep it, fall back to blanket). 

896 

897 Numbering is authoritative over the admitting rule: a numbered candidate is 

898 binned by its styleKey regardless of whether series / bold / centered 

899 admitted it (a bold list item is still a list item). 

900 """ 

901 if d.rule_trail and d.rule_trail[0] == "outline": 

902 return None 

903 if d.font_size_pt is not None and fs is not None and d.font_size_pt > fs: 

904 return None 

905 cls = d.numbering 

906 if cls is not None: 906 ↛ 912line 906 didn't jump to line 912 because the condition on line 906 was always true

907 if cls.style_key in (CN_CHAPTER, EN_CHAPTER): 907 ↛ 908line 907 didn't jump to line 908 because the condition on line 907 was never true

908 return None 

909 if cls.style_key == MULTI_LEVEL_NUM: 

910 return f"mln_raw{cls.raw_level or 2}" 

911 return _CB1_STAGE_BY_STYLE.get(cls.style_key) 

912 rule = d.rule_trail[0] if d.rule_trail else "" 

913 if rule.endswith("_center"): 

914 return "center" 

915 if rule.endswith("_bold"): 

916 return "bold" 

917 return None 

918 

919 

920def _cb1_ennum_is_mln_root( 

921 survivors: Sequence[HeadingDecision], 

922 ennum_members: Sequence[HeadingDecision], 

923) -> bool: 

924 """True when the same-size EnNum series is the implicit level-1 root of the 

925 MultiLevelNum family (``1 范围`` parents ``5.2``/``7.2.1``): its ordinals 

926 cover the MLN leading components. Such a root must be demoted LAST, after 

927 the whole MLN family — demoting it first orphans every sub-level. 

928 """ 

929 tops = { 

930 d.numbering.top_ordinal 

931 for d in survivors 

932 if d.numbering is not None 

933 and d.numbering.style_key == MULTI_LEVEL_NUM 

934 and d.numbering.top_ordinal is not None 

935 } 

936 if not tops: 

937 return False 

938 ennums = { 

939 d.numbering.ordinal 

940 for d in ennum_members 

941 if d.numbering is not None and d.numbering.ordinal is not None 

942 } 

943 overlap = tops & ennums 

944 return ( 

945 len(overlap) >= _CB1_ROOT_MIN_OVERLAP 

946 and len(overlap) / len(tops) >= _CB1_ROOT_OVERLAP_RATIO 

947 ) 

948 

949 

950def _cb1_ladder(stage_members: dict[str, list], ennum_root: bool) -> list[str]: 

951 """Order the non-empty stages: fixed base order, then MLN raw levels deepest 

952 first, with ``en_num`` relocated to the very end when it is the MLN root.""" 

953 ladder = [t for t in _CB1_BASE_LADDER if t in stage_members] 

954 if ennum_root and "en_num" in ladder: 

955 ladder.remove("en_num") 

956 ladder += sorted( 

957 (t for t in stage_members if t.startswith("mln_raw")), 

958 key=lambda t: -int(t[len("mln_raw") :]), 

959 ) 

960 if ennum_root and "en_num" in stage_members: 

961 ladder.append("en_num") 

962 return ladder 

963 

964 

965def _try_cb1_graduated_demotion( 

966 records: Sequence[Any], 

967 indices: Sequence[int], 

968 result: GateResult, 

969 survivors: list[HeadingDecision], 

970 *, 

971 fs_base: FsBase, 

972 threshold: float, 

973 min_inter: int, 

974 warnings: dict | None = None, 

975) -> bool: 

976 """CB1 graduated demotion, run after the look-ahead fails and before the 

977 blanket re-estimation. Demote same-size candidates one evidence tier at a 

978 time (fixed weakest-first ladder) on the strong-body+CB2 PROJECTION 

979 (``survivors``), re-checking density + inter-heading spacing after each tier. 

980 

981 On the first prefix that brings BOTH back within bounds, materialize those 

982 demotions on the REAL ``result`` (move them from ``decisions`` to 

983 ``demoted``, output-neutral, tagged for audit) and return True — the caller 

984 keeps the first-pass result and lets the normal downstream sweep run. Return 

985 False (leaving ``result`` untouched) when no prefix converges, so the caller 

986 falls back to blanket re-estimation. 

987 """ 

988 fs = fs_base.size_pt 

989 stage_of: dict[int, str] = {} 

990 stage_members: dict[str, list[HeadingDecision]] = {} 

991 for d in survivors: 

992 tag = _cb1_stage_tag(d, fs) 

993 if tag is None: 

994 continue 

995 stage_of[d.record_index] = tag 

996 stage_members.setdefault(tag, []).append(d) 

997 if not stage_members: 

998 return False # every candidate is exempt — nothing to graduate 

999 

1000 ennum_root = _cb1_ennum_is_mln_root(survivors, stage_members.get("en_num", [])) 

1001 ladder = _cb1_ladder(stage_members, ennum_root) 

1002 

1003 remaining = {d.record_index: d for d in survivors} 

1004 non_empty = result.non_empty 

1005 applied: list[str] = [] 

1006 for tag in ladder: 

1007 for d in stage_members[tag]: 

1008 remaining.pop(d.record_index, None) 

1009 applied.append(tag) 

1010 proj_density = (len(remaining) / non_empty) if non_empty else 0.0 

1011 proj = GateResult( 

1012 decisions=sorted(remaining.values(), key=lambda d: d.record_index), 

1013 fs_base=fs_base, 

1014 density=proj_density, 

1015 ) 

1016 proj_inter = _avg_inter_heading_body_chars(records, indices, proj) 

1017 proj_sparse = proj_inter is not None and proj_inter < min_inter 

1018 if proj_density > threshold or proj_sparse: 

1019 continue 

1020 

1021 # Converged — materialize the demotions on the real first-pass result. 

1022 # The loop above never mutated ``result``, so a non-converging exit 

1023 # leaves it byte-for-byte intact for the blanket fallback. 

1024 demoted_idx = {d.record_index for tg in applied for d in stage_members[tg]} 

1025 kept: list[HeadingDecision] = [] 

1026 for d in result.decisions: 

1027 if d.record_index in demoted_idx: 

1028 # Output-neutral: non-outline (exempt), so use_raw_text stays 

1029 # off → same body rendering as no decision. The rule trail keeps 

1030 # the original admitting rule plus the demotion marks so the 

1031 # per-paragraph audit ledger explains WHY it became body. 

1032 d.is_heading = False 

1033 d.note("cb1_graduated_demoted") 

1034 d.note(f"cb1_stage:{stage_of[d.record_index]}") 

1035 result.demoted.append(d) 

1036 else: 

1037 kept.append(d) 

1038 result.decisions = kept 

1039 result.density = (len(kept) / non_empty) if non_empty else 0.0 

1040 result.cb1_graduated_stages = applied 

1041 result.cb1_graduated_demoted = len(demoted_idx) 

1042 result.cb1_graduated_density = proj_density 

1043 result.cb1_graduated_inter_chars = proj_inter 

1044 result.cb1_graduated_ennum_root = ennum_root 

1045 if warnings is not None: 1045 ↛ 1049line 1045 didn't jump to line 1049 because the condition on line 1045 was always true

1046 warnings["smart_cb1_graduated_demotions"] = warnings.get( 

1047 "smart_cb1_graduated_demotions", 0 

1048 ) + len(demoted_idx) 

1049 logger.info( 

1050 "[smart_heading] CB1 graduated: demoted %d candidate(s) over stages " 

1051 "%s%s, projected density %.0f%%->%.0f%% (threshold %.0f%%), inter %s " 

1052 "— kept first-pass result", 

1053 len(demoted_idx), 

1054 applied, 

1055 " (en_num=mln-root)" if ennum_root else "", 

1056 result.density * 100, # informational; real ratio after demotion 

1057 proj_density * 100, 

1058 threshold * 100, 

1059 f"{proj_inter:.0f}" if proj_inter is not None else "n/a", 

1060 ) 

1061 return True 

1062 return False 

1063 

1064 

1065def gate_with_cb1( 

1066 records: Sequence[Any], 

1067 indices: Sequence[int], 

1068 *, 

1069 fs_base: FsBase, 

1070 baseline_density: float = 0.0, 

1071 warnings: dict | None = None, 

1072 **gate_kwargs: Any, 

1073) -> GateResult: 

1074 """Run the gate; on CB1 overflow (density > threshold, or the average 

1075 body chars between adjacent candidates below 

1076 ``DOCX_SMART_MIN_INTER_HEADING_CHARS`` — trigger side only): 

1077 

1078 1. Look-ahead: project the downstream strong-body + CB2 series-propagation 

1079 sweep onto a throwaway copy of the candidates and re-measure density. 

1080 The raw first-pass density counts numbered body-in-disguise (e.g. a run 

1081 of ``CnParentNum`` "(一)…。" clauses) whose strong-body demotion is 

1082 deferred to that post-merge sweep — and the sweep is skipped once the 

1083 breaker trips. If the projected density falls back under threshold, the 

1084 sub-document is not truly over-detected: withhold the trip, keep the

1086 sweep do the real demotion. Genuine same-size numbered headings (``一、``) 

1087 survive instead of being wiped by the blanket re-estimation below. 

1088 2. Graduated demotion: if the projection still overflows, demote same-size 

1089 candidates one evidence tier at a time (weakest body-prior first; 

1090 MultiLevelNum last and deepest-level-first) until density + spacing fall 

1091 back within bounds, keeping the first-pass result. This recovers the 

1092 upper tiers of a numbered outline whose lower tiers pushed density over

1097 same-size paths off, sizes above the new body size still auto-admit).

1265def assign_levels_by_size(decisions: list[HeadingDecision]) -> None:

1270 the numbering classes — non-MultiLevelNum keys ordered by (priority, 

1271 unit sub-order) on one track while MultiLevelNum raw levels advance an

1273 the two tracks are legal) — and uncentered-unnumbered last (deepest).

1277 return

1287 has_uncentered_plain = any( 

1288 (not d.centered) and d.numbering is None for d in members

1290 numbered = [d for d in members if d.numbering is not None]

1293 cursor = next_level

1296 cursor += 1 

1297 

1298 # Numbering classes present in this band, ordered by 

1299 # (priority, unit sub-order); MultiLevelNum occupies ONE slot on 

1300 # this track while its raw levels advance independently.

1302 seen_keys: set[tuple] = set() 

1303 for d in numbered: 

1304 cls = d.numbering 

1305 if cls.style_key == MULTI_LEVEL_NUM: 

1306 key = (MULTI_LEVEL_NUM,)

1308 key = (cls.style_key, cls.unit)

1310 seen_keys.add(key) 

1311 class_keys.append(key) 

1312 

1313 def _class_sort(key: tuple):

1316 style = key[0] 

1317 rank = unit_rank(style, key[1]) if len(key) > 1 else None 

1318 return (STYLE_KEY_PRIORITY[style], rank if rank is not None else 99) 

1319 

1320 class_keys.sort(key=_class_sort)

1322 numbering_base = cursor 

1323 class_level: dict[tuple, int] = {}

1328 mln_raws = sorted( 

1329 { 

1330 d.numbering.raw_level 

1331 for d in numbered 

1332 if d.numbering.style_key == MULTI_LEVEL_NUM 

1333 and d.numbering.raw_level is not None 

1334 } 

1335 )

1337 mln_raw_level: dict[int, int] = {} 

1338 if mln_base_level is not None and mln_raws:

1346 cursor += 1

1348 band_levels[band] = {

1350 "classes": class_level, 

1351 "mln": mln_raw_level, 

1352 } 

1353 next_level = cursor

1427 def _ordinal_linkage(members: list[HeadingDecision]) -> set[int]:

1439 n = parent.numbering.ordinal 

1440 if n is None: 1440 ↛ 1441line 1440 didn't jump to line 1441 because the condition on line 1440 was never true

1441 continue

1444 ordered[pos + 1].record_index

1449 d.numbering.top_ordinal 

1450 for d in mln

1553def _collect_series_group(

1678def anchor_outline_levels( 

1679 decisions: list[HeadingDecision], *, warnings: dict | None = None 

1680) -> bool: 

1681 """Re-anchor size-derived levels onto the physical outline. 

1682 

1683 Round 1 — non-numbered outlined headings snap to ``outlineLvl + 1``; 

1684 a numbered series with ≥1 outlined member snaps the WHOLE series to the 

1685 mode of its members' outline levels (ties toward the shallower level; 

1686 CB3 warns when fewer than half the members carry an outline but still 

1687 propagates). Anchored headings record their pre-anchor level. 

1688 

1689 Round 2 — every maximal run of unanchored headings between anchors is 

1690 adjusted: the leading anchor's shift is followed by its immediate 

1691 subtree (stopping at the first heading not deeper than the anchor's 

1692 new level); when the trailing anchor moved SHALLOWER (R2 < R1), the 

1693 remaining sub-window shifts with it — as a whole when it still holds 

1694 levels ≥ R1, else just enough (max(0, L0 - R2 + 1)) to close the gap. 

1695 A trailing anchor that moved deeper adjusts nothing. Levels floor at 1 

1696 (a floored shift records a compression warning). Every heading ends 

1697 the pass outline-locked. 

1698 

1699 Returns False (and changes nothing) when no heading carries an outline. 

1700 """ 

1701 if not any(d.outline_level is not None and not d.is_title_block for d in decisions): 

1702 return False 

1703 

1704 # --- round 1 ----------------------------------------------------------- 

1705 for d in decisions: 

1706 if d.is_title_block or d.numbering is not None: 

1707 continue 

1708 if d.outline_level is not None: 

1709 d.pre_anchor_level = d.level 

1710 d.level = d.outline_level + 1 

1711 d.anchored = True 

1712 d.note("anchor_outline_direct") 

1713 

1714 for group in _all_series_groups(decisions): 

1715 members = [decisions[p] for p in group] 

1716 outlined = [m for m in members if m.outline_level is not None] 

1717 if not outlined: 

1718 continue 

1719 weights: dict[int, int] = {} 

1720 for m in outlined: 

1721 lv = m.outline_level + 1 

1722 weights[lv] = weights.get(lv, 0) + 1 

1723 top = max(weights.values()) 

1724 mode = min(lv for lv, w in weights.items() if w == top) 

1725 if len(outlined) * 2 < len(members): 

1726 if warnings is not None: 1726 ↛ 1730line 1726 didn't jump to line 1730 because the condition on line 1726 was always true

1727 warnings["smart_cb3_low_outline_ratio"] = ( 

1728 warnings.get("smart_cb3_low_outline_ratio", 0) + 1 

1729 ) 

1730 logger.warning( 

1731 "[smart_heading] CB3: only %d/%d members of a numbering " 

1732 "series carry a physical outline; propagating level %d anyway", 

1733 len(outlined), 

1734 len(members), 

1735 mode, 

1736 ) 

1737 for m in members: 

1738 m.pre_anchor_level = m.level 

1739 m.level = mode 

1740 m.anchored = True 

1741 # whole series' level derives from physical outline evidence — a 

1742 # no-outline member (1) must not be split off by the subtree 

1743 # demotion while its outlined siblings (2)/3) survive. 

1744 m.outline_anchored = True 

1745 m.note("anchor_outline_series")

1826# heading merge and strong-body demotion sweep 

1827# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

1828 

1829_MERGE_MAX_LINES = 4 

1830 

1831#: How much heavier than the merge owner its members must COLLECTIVELY be for 

1832#: the owner's own physical outline to arm the joined-text gate. Both sides of 

1833#: the comparison are fixed points — the owner's ORIGINAL weight and the running 

1834#: total of everything absorbed — never the accumulated join: comparing each 

1835#: member against a window that already swallowed the previous ones makes the 

1836#: criterion path-dependent and monotonically harder to meet, so members that 

1837#: individually stay under the ratio can still swamp the owner together (14 + 

1838#: 20 + 60 + 100 clears a 180 cap while every successive 2x check passes). 

1839#: Calibrated against the two measured shapes (weighted en-equivalent chars, 

1840#: cap 180): 

1841#: - 【政策内容】 (14) absorbing a 312-char citation — ratio 22: the join reads 

1842#: as body entirely because of the NEIGHBOUR, and committing it costs a real 

1843#: baseline heading its identity; 

1844#: - _Medical Graph RAG.docx's author line (96) absorbing its affiliation line 

1845#: (103) — ratio 1.07: two comparably meaty lines that only cross the body 

1846#: threshold TOGETHER, exactly the merge-then-demote-together case the gate 

1847#: must not break (that .docx marks the author list as outlineLvl=1, so the 

1848#: outline evidence itself is dirty and cannot be trusted on its own). 

1849#: 2.0 sits in the wide gap between them. Raising it toward 22 or lowering it 

1850#: toward 1.07 narrows one of those margins — do not tune without re-running the 

1851#: corpus A/B. 

1852_MERGE_OUTLINE_OWNER_OUTWEIGH_RATIO = 2.0 

1853 

1854 

1855def _members_outweigh_owner(owner_weight: int, absorbed_weight: int) -> bool: 

1856 """Have the absorbed members collectively swamped the merge owner? 

1857 

1858 ``owner_weight`` is the owner's ORIGINAL weighted length and 

1859 ``absorbed_weight`` the running total of every member taken so far, 

1860 including the one under consideration. True means whatever makes the joined 

1861 text read as body comes from the MEMBERS, not from the owner — so a merge 

1862 that the sweep would then demote trades a real heading for a body paragraph. 

1863 

1864 Monotonic in ``absorbed_weight``, hence sticky by construction: once the 

1865 members outweigh the owner they cannot un-outweigh it later in the window. 

1866 """ 

1867 if owner_weight <= 0: 1867 ↛ 1868line 1867 didn't jump to line 1868 because the condition on line 1867 was never true

1868 return False 

1869 return absorbed_weight >= _MERGE_OUTLINE_OWNER_OUTWEIGH_RATIO * owner_weight

1872def merge_split_headings( 

1873 decisions: list[HeadingDecision], 

1874 records: Sequence[Any], 

1875 *, 

1876 strong_body: Callable[[str], str | None] | None = None, 

1877 warnings: dict | None = None, 

1878) -> list[HeadingDecision]: 

1879 """Re-join headings the author split for line-spacing looks. 

1880 

1881 Adjacent same-level headings with the same font size (bold ignored) 

1882 merge — "adjacent" tolerates ONE empty paragraph between them; a 

1883 numbered heading may only START a merge (never be absorbed); the merged 

1884 text (soft-break lines + paragraph splits) is capped at 4 lines. 

1885 Returns the compacted decision list (absorbed members removed). 

1886 

1887 Two strong-body gates keep a merge from destroying a real heading. They 

1888 exist because this pass sits BETWEEN candidate admission and 

1889 :func:`demote_strong_body_headings`, and admission DEFERS the strong-body 

1890 check for clause-class numbered candidates (see ``EARLY_STRONG_BODY_KEYS``) 

1891 — so a candidate whose body verdict is still pending can reach this pass: 

1892 

1893 - a ``cur`` that already reads as body may not absorb anything: re-joining 

1894 "a heading the author split for looks" is meaningless for a line that is 

1895 a full sentence, and absorbing a neighbour would hide that neighbour's 

1896 text inside a paragraph the sweep is about to demote; 

1897 - once the window holds (or is about to take) a member carrying a physical 

1898 outline level, every further join is rejected when the JOINED text reads 

1899 as body. The flag is STICKY on purpose: the window grows up to 

1900 ``_MERGE_MAX_LINES`` members, so an outline member absorbed early must 

1901 keep protecting the window when a later, outline-free member is what 

1902 finally pushes the join over the body threshold. Committing such a merge 

1903 would let the sweep undo it and strand the outline member without a 

1904 decision — an invariant-I2 violation that costs the WHOLE document its 

1905 smart output (see :func:`_register_merge_members`); 

1906 - the same gate arms when the OWNER is the one carrying the outline and the 

1907 members COLLECTIVELY outweigh it (:func:`_members_outweigh_owner`, fed the 

1908 owner's original weight and the running member total — never the 

1909 accumulated join, which would let members that each stay under the ratio 

1910 swamp the owner together). This mirror image 

1911 fails differently and more quietly: the owner is what the sweep demotes, 

1912 and ``strong_body_demoted`` IS whitelisted by 

1913 :func:`guardrails.verify_baseline_heading_retention`, so I2 does NOT trip 

1914 and no fallback rescues the document — a real baseline heading just 

1915 becomes body. Owner outline alone is NOT enough to arm it: a .docx that 

1916 marks a 96-char author list as ``outlineLvl=1`` is dirty evidence, and the 

1917 merge-then-demote-together outcome is right there. The weight ratio is 

1918 what separates the two. 

1919 

1920 The joined-text gate is verdict-identical to the sweep's own test: same 

1921 predicate, same ``(text, outline_level)`` arguments, and nothing mutates 

1922 either between the two calls. It is scoped to outline-carrying windows 

1923 deliberately — an unconditional version would break the useful case where 

1924 two body-ish lines are only long enough to be demoted TOGETHER (each would 

1925 then survive alone as a spurious heading). 

1926 """ 

1927 strong_body = strong_body or guardrails.strong_body_reason 

1928 out: list[HeadingDecision] = [] 

1929 pos = 0 

1930 while pos < len(decisions): 

1931 cur = decisions[pos] 

1932 if not cur.is_heading or cur.is_title_block: 1932 ↛ 1933line 1932 didn't jump to line 1933 because the condition on line 1932 was never true

1933 out.append(cur) 

1934 pos += 1 

1935 continue 

1936 owner_reason, _owner_spared = _strong_body_with_outline_context( 

1937 cur.text, cur.outline_level, strong_body 

1938 ) 

1939 if owner_reason is not None: 

1940 out.append(cur) # a body line absorbs nothing 

1941 pos += 1 

1942 continue 

1943 lines = cur.text.count("\n") + 1 

1944 merged_members = [cur.record_index] 

1945 absorbed_outline = False # sticky: a baseline heading is in the window 

1946 owner_weight = guardrails.weighted_char_length(cur.text.strip()) 

1947 absorbed_weight = 0 # running total of the members taken so far 

1948 k = pos + 1 

1949 while k < len(decisions): 

1950 nxt = decisions[k] 

1951 if not nxt.is_heading or nxt.is_title_block: 1951 ↛ 1952line 1951 didn't jump to line 1952 because the condition on line 1951 was never true

1952 break 

1953 if nxt.numbering is not None: 

1954 break # a numbered heading only ever starts a merge 

1955 if nxt.level != cur.level or nxt.font_size_pt != cur.font_size_pt: 

1956 break 

1957 # Adjacency: between the two records only empty paragraphs, at 

1958 # most one. 

1959 between = records[merged_members[-1] + 1 : nxt.record_index] 

1960 if len(between) > 1 or any(r.kind != "empty_para" for r in between): 

1961 break 

1962 nxt_lines = nxt.text.count("\n") + 1 

1963 if lines + nxt_lines > _MERGE_MAX_LINES: 

1964 break 

1965 joined = _join_heading_texts(cur.text, nxt.text) 

1966 absorbed_weight += guardrails.weighted_char_length(nxt.text.strip()) 

1967 # Outer guard: a window with no outline at stake never pays for this 

1968 # extra NLP judgment. 

1969 if ( 

1970 absorbed_outline 

1971 or nxt.outline_level is not None 

1972 or ( 

1973 cur.outline_level is not None 

1974 and _members_outweigh_owner(owner_weight, absorbed_weight) 

1975 ) 

1976 ): 

1977 joined_reason, _joined_spared = _strong_body_with_outline_context( 

1978 joined, cur.outline_level, strong_body 

1979 ) 

1980 if joined_reason is not None: 

1981 break 

1982 cur.text = joined 

1983 if nxt.outline_level is not None: 

1984 absorbed_outline = True 

1985 lines += nxt_lines 

1986 merged_members.append(nxt.record_index) 

1987 cur.note("heading_merge") 

1988 if warnings is not None: 1988 ↛ 1992line 1988 didn't jump to line 1992 because the condition on line 1988 was always true

1989 warnings["smart_heading_merges"] = ( 

1990 warnings.get("smart_heading_merges", 0) + 1 

1991 ) 

1992 k += 1 

1993 if len(merged_members) > 1: 

1994 cur.member_indices = tuple(merged_members) 

1995 out.append(cur) 

1996 pos = k if k > pos + 1 else pos + 1 

1997 return out

2000def _register_merge_members( 

2001 decisions: dict[int, HeadingDecision], 

2002 d: HeadingDecision, 

2003 records: Sequence[Any], 

2004 warnings: dict, 

2005) -> None: 

2006 """Register the absorbed members of a merged heading — three cases. 

2007 

2008 - the merged heading SURVIVED → an ``absorbed`` sentinel per member, so the 

2009 assembler skips its standalone row (its text is already inside the 

2010 heading); 

2011 - the merge was UNDONE by a later stage (the post-merge strong-body sweep or 

2012 clamping) and the member carries NO physical outline → the joined text is 

2013 never rendered, so the member emits its own paragraph text. Record that 

2014 with an AUDIT-ONLY ``merge_unwound`` decision: ``absorbed`` and 

2015 ``use_raw_text`` both stay off, which is the same assembler path an 

2016 absent decision takes, so the output is byte-identical — the row only 

2017 replaces an anonymous gap with a traceable one. Invariant I2 never 

2018 inspects a non-outline record, so retention semantics are untouched; 

2019 - the merge was UNDONE and the member IS a baseline (outlineLvl) heading → 

2020 write NOTHING, deliberately. The member must not be silently 

2021 re-classified as body: leaving the gap is what makes I2 trip and hand the 

2022 document to the baseline assembler, which still emits that paragraph AS a 

2023 heading. Whitelisting a demotion rule here would suppress the fallback 

2024 and genuinely lose the heading boundary. 

2025 

2026 The strong-body gates in :func:`merge_split_headings` close the direct 

2027 sweep route into the third case. What remains is the sweep's 

2028 ``subtree_demoted`` cascade (a NUMBERED merge owner inside a demoted 

2029 parent's subtree) and :func:`clamp_deep_levels` (level > 9); both are 

2030 warned about so the event is diagnosable instead of mysterious. 

2031 

2032 Separately, an undone merge whose OWNER carries a physical outline is 

2033 counted as ``smart_merge_outline_owner_demoted``. That case does not violate 

2034 I2 — the owner holds a whitelisted ``strong_body_demoted`` / 

2035 ``clamp_gt9_demoted`` tag, so nothing trips and no fallback runs — which is 

2036 exactly why it needs its own counter: the heading is gone and the only other 

2037 trace is an aggregate ``smart_strong_body_demotions`` that cannot be 

2038 attributed to a merge. The weight-ratio gate in 

2039 :func:`merge_split_headings` closes the direct route here too; the residual 

2040 routes are the same cascade and clamp. 

2041 

2042 A member's own decision is NOT restored as a heading: its level is the 

2043 product of the whole per-sub-document pipeline (series alignment, 

2044 anchoring, gap closing, nesting, clamping — all cross-paragraph set 

2045 operations), so re-inserting one after the fact cannot be shown coherent. 

2046 Likewise the surviving owner keeps the JOINED text in ``d.text`` after an 

2047 undone merge; that value only feeds the audit summary (output reads 

2048 ``rec.text``), and restoring it would mean teaching the merge about 

2049 downstream demotion. 

2050 """ 

2051 if not d.is_heading and records[d.record_index].outline_level is not None: 

2052 warnings["smart_merge_outline_owner_demoted"] = ( 

2053 warnings.get("smart_merge_outline_owner_demoted", 0) + 1 

2054 ) 

2055 logger.warning( 

2056 "[smart_heading] outline paragraph %d lost its heading identity as " 

2057 "the owner of an undone heading merge; I2 does not cover this case " 

2058 "(the demotion rule is whitelisted), so nothing else reports it", 

2059 d.record_index, 

2060 ) 

2061 for m in d.member_indices[1:]: 

2062 if d.is_heading: 

2063 member = HeadingDecision(record_index=m, text="", absorbed=True) 

2064 member.note("merged_absorbed") 

2065 decisions[m] = member 

2066 continue 

2067 if records[m].outline_level is not None: 

2068 warnings["smart_merge_outline_stranded"] = ( 

2069 warnings.get("smart_merge_outline_stranded", 0) + 1 

2070 ) 

2071 logger.warning( 

2072 "[smart_heading] I2: outline paragraph %d stranded by an undone " 

2073 "heading merge — deferring to the baseline fallback", 

2074 m, 

2075 ) 

2076 continue # no decision on purpose: the I2 fallback keeps the heading 

2077 member = HeadingDecision(record_index=m, text=records[m].text) 

2078 member.note("merge_unwound") 

2079 warnings["smart_merge_unwound"] = warnings.get("smart_merge_unwound", 0) + 1 

2080 decisions[m] = member 

2081

2083def demote_strong_body_headings( 

2084 decisions: list[HeadingDecision], 

2085 *, 

2086 strong_body: Callable[[str], str | None] | None = None, 

2087 warnings: dict | None = None, 

2088) -> None: 

2089 """Post-merge sweep: every remaining heading is re-checked for 

2090 strong-body features; hits demote to body. A numbered hit propagates the 

2091 demotion to its whole same-series group unless CB2 trips (fewer than 20% 

2092 of the group hit, or ≥50% of the group carries a physical outline) — a 

2093 tripped breaker demotes only the hits themselves, with a warning. 

2094 

2095 Finally each demoted heading takes its NUMBERED subtree (the deeper 

2096 numbered headings it parents) down with it — an orphaned deeper numbered 

2097 child would otherwise re-anchor to the wrong parent and swallow the 

2098 following content. An unnumbered deeper heading is NOT cascaded (its depth 

2099 is only a size/style heuristic — it is left to close_unnumbered_level_gaps); 

2100 a heading with physical-outline evidence (its own outlineLvl, or a 

2101 same-series member anchored to the outline in anchor_outline_levels round 1) 

2102 is a hard 

2103 boundary that is never demoted by ancestor propagation nor split off from 

2104 its series (it keeps only whatever its own strong-body / CB2 evidence 

2105 already gave it). The scan stops at either kind of boundary."""

2261def _habitual_shallower(a: _SkeletonNode, b: _SkeletonNode, decisions) -> bool: 

2262 """Whether class ``a`` habitually sits shallower than ``b``.""" 

2263 from .style_key import STYLE_KEY_PRIORITY

2266 cb = decisions[b.first_pos].numbering 

2267 if ca.style_key == MULTI_LEVEL_NUM and cb.style_key == MULTI_LEVEL_NUM:

2270 ub = _GLOBAL_UNIT_ORDER.get(cb.unit) if cb.unit else None 

2271 if ua is not None and ub is not None and ua != ub: 

2272 return ua < ub 

2273 return STYLE_KEY_PRIORITY[ca.style_key] < STYLE_KEY_PRIORITY[cb.style_key]

2627def close_unnumbered_level_gaps( 

2628 decisions: list[HeadingDecision], *, warnings: dict | None = None 

2629) -> None: 

2630 """Lift unnumbered headings over levels vacated by demotion. 

2631 

2632 ``assign_levels_by_size`` hands each numbering class a slot BETWEEN the 

2633 centered-plain and uncentered-plain tracks; when the post-merge sweep 

2634 later demotes such a class wholesale (e.g. patent claims 

2635 ``1、…`` matched as an EnNum series), its slot empties and the unnumbered 

2636 headings below it are stranded one-or-more levels too deep (title L1 / 

2637 sections L3 with nothing at L2). 

2638 

2639 Unnumbered headings carry no same-series equality constraint, so they — 

2640 and ONLY they — may move: ascending over the surviving occupied levels, 

2641 a level whose headings are all movable (unnumbered, no physical outline, 

2642 not a title block) snaps to one below the nearest surviving level above; 

2643 every other level is pinned at its value, which keeps same-series 

2644 equality, MultiLevelNum's deliberate raw-level gaps, and outline levels 

2645 (I3) intact. A mixed level (movable and pinned members) is conservatively 

2646 pinned. ``remap[L] <= L`` always holds (lift-only), and a movable level 

2647 lands at ``running + 1`` — strictly below every pinned level processed so 

2648 far — so it never collides with or crosses a surviving numbered heading. 

2649 

2650 Scope: this pass repairs unnumbered headings THEMSELVES, not the numeric 

2651 contiguity of their numbered descendants. A 

2652 pinned child already deeper than a lifted parent keeps its level (the 

2653 downstream nest pass is one-directional and never pulls a deeper child 

2654 up), leaving a documented numeric gap; heading ORDER (child strictly 

2655 deeper than parent) is preserved, which is all the chunker's parent-path 

2656 resolution needs. 

2657 

2658 ``anchored`` is deliberately NOT consulted: anchoring round 2 flags every 

2659 processed heading ``anchored=True`` as bookkeeping (not an outline lock — 

2660 see :func:`_shift_subtree_unlocked`); genuine outline pinning is the 

2661 ``outline_level`` check. 

2662 """ 

2663 survivors = [d for d in decisions if d.is_heading and d.level is not None] 

2664 if not survivors: 

2665 return 

2666 

2667 def _movable(d: HeadingDecision) -> bool: 

2668 return d.numbering is None and d.outline_level is None and not d.is_title_block 

2669 

2670 by_level: dict[int, list[HeadingDecision]] = {} 

2671 for d in survivors: 

2672 by_level.setdefault(d.level, []).append(d) 

2673 

2674 remap: dict[int, int] = {} 

2675 running = 0 # deepest new level assigned so far 

2676 for level in sorted(by_level): 

2677 if all(_movable(d) for d in by_level[level]): 

2678 remap[level] = running + 1 # snap below the nearest level above 

2679 else: 

2680 remap[level] = level # pinned: series / MLN gaps / outline stay 

2681 running = max(running, remap[level]) 

2682 

2683 for level, members in by_level.items(): 

2684 if remap[level] == level: # pinned levels always map to themselves 

2685 continue 

2686 for d in members: 

2687 d.level = remap[level] 

2688 d.note("unnumbered_gap_closed") 

2689 if warnings is not None: 

2690 warnings["smart_unnumbered_gap_closed"] = warnings.get( 

2691 "smart_unnumbered_gap_closed", 0 

2692 ) + len(members) 

2693

2855def _demote_confirmed_imprint_regions( 

2856 records: Sequence[Any], 

2857 decisions: dict[int, HeadingDecision], 

2858 regions: Sequence[Any], 

2859 title_indices: Sequence[int], 

2860 warnings: dict | None, 

2861 skip_indices: set[int] = frozenset(), 

2862) -> None: 

2863 """Force a confirmed 公文版记 region's lines to body (conditional). 

2864 

2865 A region is CONFIRMED — 100% 版记, not a false imprint hit — only when its 

2866 closer is IMMEDIATELY followed by a valid title block: the first CONTENT 

2867 record after the region tail (blanks / section breaks / TOC lines / pure 

2868 ``<drawing/>`` logo paragraphs skipped — ``title_block.is_content_record``, 

2869 the SAME eyes the ``imprint_single`` walk and the position gate use; a 

2870 cover those walks admit must also confirm its region, or the 版记 lines 

2871 silently stay headings) BELONGS to a title block. ``title_indices`` is the 

2872 full member-index set: a multi window that opens on an image paragraph 

2873 keys its decision on that image, so the first CONTENT record the scan 

2874 lands on is the block's title line, a member — matching starts only 

2875 would silently fail to confirm. Then every region member that is STILL a 

2876 heading is demoted to body with a rule-tagged decision 

2877 (``strong_body_demoted`` keeps invariant I2 green); members already body 

2878 are output-neutral and left untouched. The preceding signature/date 

2879 lines (``reg.preceding``) are NEVER demoted — they are the previous 

2880 document's own content, only vetoed from title-block absorption. 

2881 """ 

2882 from . import title_block as tb 

2883 

2884 valid_indices = set(title_indices) 

2885 n = len(records) 

2886 for reg in regions: 

2887 if reg.closer is None: 

2888 continue 

2889 # Scan from the region's LAST member (a trailing 成文日期 absorbed after 

2890 # the closer extends the region past reg.closer), not the closer itself. 

2891 j = max(reg.members) + 1 

2892 while j < n and not tb.is_content_record(j, records[j], skip_indices): 

2893 j += 1 

2894 if j >= n or j not in valid_indices: 

2895 continue # no title block right after → veto-only, not confirmed 

2896 for idx in sorted(reg.members): 

2897 existing = decisions.get(idx) 

2898 if existing is None or not existing.is_heading: 

2899 continue # already body — output-neutral, don't re-tag/re-count 

2900 rec = records[idx] 

2901 dem = HeadingDecision( 

2902 record_index=idx, 

2903 text=rec.text, 

2904 is_heading=False, 

2905 outline_level=rec.outline_level, 

2906 use_raw_text=True, 

2907 ) 

2908 dem.note("imprint_region") 

2909 dem.note("strong_body_demoted") 

2910 decisions[idx] = dem 

2911 if warnings is not None: 2911 ↛ 2915line 2911 didn't jump to line 2915 because the condition on line 2911 was always true

2912 warnings["smart_imprint_region_demotions"] = ( 

2913 warnings.get("smart_imprint_region_demotions", 0) + 1 

2914 ) 

2915 logger.warning( 

2916 "[smart_heading] imprint region line demoted to body — a title " 

2917 "block follows the 版记 (record %d)", 

2918 idx, 

2919 )

2922def _memoized_strong_body( 

2923 fn: Callable[[str], str | None], 

2924) -> Callable[[str], str | None]: 

2925 """Per-parse memo for the strong-body verdict. The verdict is a pure 

2926 function of the paragraph text within one parse (the length env is 

2927 constant), so the gate, the CB1 look-ahead, and the post-merge demotion

2931 across documents or survives an env change between parses."""

2934 def _cached(text: str) -> str | None: 

2935 if text not in cache: 

2936 cache[text] = fn(text) 

2937 return cache[text] 

2938 

2939 return _cached
